groupsAdultAge.citation: The youngest age in the survey tabulation of group membership (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsStayOutCongregation.citation: The pull of staying out of a congregation's activities, calibrated over three drawn towns so a town's share lands near the survey's 19.4% taking part in a religious organization beyond services (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsStayOutSchool.citation: The pull of staying out of a school group or neighborhood association, calibrated over three drawn towns toward the survey's 13.9% (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsStayOutService.citation: The pull of staying out of a service or civic organization (service clubs, veterans' posts, fraternal and business groups), calibrated over three drawn towns toward the survey's 6.8% (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsStayOutSports.citation: The pull of staying out of a sports or recreation organization, calibrated over three drawn towns toward the survey's 9.9% (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsStayOutOther.citation: The pull of staying out of other groups (advocacy, volunteer and arts groups), calibrated over three drawn towns toward the survey's 5.0% (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsEducationWeight.citation: How much schooling pulls toward belonging: in the survey, adults with a bachelor's degree took part in some group at 47.8% against 26.8% for high school graduates (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsSociabilityWeight.citation: How much sociability pulls toward belonging; a starting value.

groupsEngagementWeight.citation: How much following public life pulls toward belonging; a starting value.

groupsAgeWeight.citation: How much age pulls toward belonging: in the survey, taking part in some group rises from 28.3% at 18-29 to 40.9% at 65 and over (Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013 (the last to ask by group type, items PES5a-e), adults 18+, weighted by PWNRWGT; OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).

groupsAgeSpread.citation: Years over which the age pull falls off.

groupsJobTimeWeight.citation: How much a job's hours pull against evenings out; a starting value.

groupsSkipPull.citation: The pull of skipping a gathering against a member's reasons to go, on the same scale.

groupsGatheringPeers.citation: How many fellow members a person spends a gathering with.

groupsMonthlyDays.citation: Days between a club's meetings: service clubs, veterans' posts and neighborhood associations commonly meet monthly.

groupsHoursService.citation: Hours of a weekly religious gathering, about a service and the time around it; ATUS 2023 counts about 1.6 hours a day of religious and spiritual activities on the days people do them.
groupsHoursService.estimatedFrom: BLS American Time Use Survey 2023, Table 11; spread 1 to 2.5

groupsHoursMeeting.citation: Hours of a club or league gathering; ATUS 2023 counts about 2 hours a day of volunteer and organizational activities on the days people do them.
groupsHoursMeeting.estimatedFrom: BLS American Time Use Survey 2023, Table 11; spread 1 to 3

groupsAgeCenterOlder.citation: The age where belonging to a congregation, service club, veterans' post, fraternal society or neighborhood association pulls most: service and civic membership rises from 3.4% at 18-29 to 11.0% at 65 and over, religious from 12.9% to 25.9% (Census CPS Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013, OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).
groupsAgeCenterOlder.estimatedFrom: The survey's highest band for these kinds; spread 60 to 75

groupsAgeCenterParents.citation: The age where a parent-teacher group pulls most: school and neighborhood groups peak at 18.6% at 30-44 (Census CPS Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013, OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).
groupsAgeCenterParents.estimatedFrom: The survey's peak band; spread 35 to 45

groupsAgeCenterMiddle.citation: The age where business, advocacy, volunteer and arts groups pull most: 'other' groups rise from 3.4% at 18-29 to 7.3% at 65 and over, flatter than service groups (Census CPS Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013, OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).
groupsAgeCenterMiddle.estimatedFrom: Between the survey's bands; spread 40 to 60

groupsAgeCenterYounger.citation: The age where sports and recreation organizations pull most: 13.3% at 30-44 against 6.0% at 65 and over (Census CPS Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013, OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).
groupsAgeCenterYounger.estimatedFrom: The survey's peak band; spread 25 to 45

groupsStayOutNeighborhood.citation: The pull of staying out of a neighborhood association, calibrated over six drawn towns with parent-teacher groups toward the survey's 13.9% in school or neighborhood groups (Census CPS Civic Engagement Supplement, November 2013, OPUS-PEOPLE's tabulation in data/research/groups/membership-rates.json).
